text:
“Engineering is 85 % complete.” Then why can site not build?

Because we count drawings issued, not drawings we can build from.

An IFC drawing with ten holds is not issued for construction. It is issued for waiting.

What I count instead:
• drawings with zero holds, by area
• every hold by age: how long it has been open, and who owns it
• the construction activity each hold is blocking, and its date
• the vendor data still missing behind each hold

And one number for the weekly report: buildable drawings against the drawings site needs in the next eight weeks.

Engineering progress tells you how busy the design office is. Buildable progress tells you whether site can work.

How does your project count a drawing with holds: issued, or not issued?
